- [tests/billing/updateAccountPermission.spec.ts](tests/billing/updateAccountPermission.spec.ts): account editing/rebalancing permissions for facility admin, admin, and nurse.

- [tests/facility/billing/accountTransfer.spec.ts](tests/facility/billing/accountTransfer.spec.ts)

- [tests/facility/services/locations/locations.spec.ts](tests/facility/services/locations/locations.spec.ts)
- [tests/facility/services/locations/inventory/toDispatch.spec.ts](tests/facility/services/locations/inventory/toDispatch.spec.ts)
- [tests/facility/services/locations/inventory/toReceive.spec.ts](tests/facility/services/locations/inventory/toReceive.spec.ts)
- [tests/facility/services/service.spec.ts](tests/facility/services/service.spec.ts): creates a pharmacy-type service, tests service switching.
- [tests/facility/patient/encounter/medicine/prescriptionCreate.spec.ts](tests/facility/patient/encounter/medicine/prescriptionCreate.spec.ts)
- [tests/facility/patient/encounter/medicine/prescriptionEdit.spec.ts](tests/facility/patient/encounter/medicine/prescriptionEdit.spec.ts)

**2. Closest Flow Templates**
All pharmacy/medication specs above use `tests/.auth/user.json`.
- **toDispatch:** `getFacilityId()` → `/facility/${facilityId}/services/` → “Main Pharmacy” link → “Pharmacy” link. Extracts location ID with `/facility/${facilityId}/locations/([^/]+)/medication_requests`. Builds `/facility/${facilityId}/locations/${pharmacyLocationId}`, then visits `/inventory/internal/dispatch`. Local `setupInitialData()` and `createStockRequest()` create a lab stock request containing Paracetamol, approve it, create pharmacy delivery orders, select stock, and verify receiving/completion. **This is stock dispatch, not patient dispensing.**
- **toReceive:** follows the same service links, then extracts the lab location from `/locations/([^/]+)/service_requests`; tests `/inventory/internal/receive`, creating and completing stock requests from Pharmacy.
- **locations:** creates a pharmacy service through `createHealthcareService()`, opens its Pharmacy location, asserts “Prescription Queue”, and tests location switching. It never selects a prescription or bills medications.
- **prescriptionCreate / prescriptionEdit:** visit `/facility/${facilityId}/encounters/patients/all?created_date_after=…&created_date_before=…&status=in_progress`, select the first “View Encounter”, then “Medicines”. Create uses the “Create” link, medication picker, dose/frequency/instructions/notes, and Submit; verifies the success toast and prescription table. Edit additionally locates a dated prescription card, edits/removes medication, and verifies inactive medications. Both use faker and [prescriptionTestData.ts](tests/facility/patient/encounter/medicine/prescriptionTestData.ts), exporting `medicineNames`, `frequencies`, and `instructions`; neither captures prescription IDs for billing.
- **medicationRequest:** uses all three ID helpers and directly visits `/facility/${facilityId}/patient/${patientId}/encounter/${encounterId}/questionnaire/medication_request`; fills medication fields, submits, then verifies the named “Medication History” dialog. Its local `selectDuration()` selects an exact-match duration suggestion.

**3. Relevant Helpers**
- [tests/support/facilityId.ts](tests/support/facilityId.ts), [patientId.ts](tests/support/patientId.ts), [encounterId.ts](tests/support/encounterId.ts), and [accountId.ts](tests/support/accountId.ts) export their respective `get…Id(): string` functions. Each reads `{id}` from `tests/.auth/{entity}Meta.json`, caches it in module memory, and synchronously runs its setup spec through `execSync()` if the file is missing. Invalid JSON/missing IDs throw; they do **not** regenerate invalid existing metadata. Encounter setup also runs the patient setup spec.
- [tests/setup/patient.setup.ts](tests/setup/patient.setup.ts) selects an existing planned/in-progress encounter from the last 90 days and saves patient/encounter IDs extracted from its URL; it does not create a fresh patient.
- [tests/helper/utils.ts](tests/helper/utils.ts): `getApiUrl()` returns `REACT_CARE_API_URL || "http://localhost:9000"`; `getApiHeaders()` reads `care_access_token` from the first origin in saved **admin** storage and returns Bearer authorization plus JSON content type. `expectedSlug()` lowercases, hyphenates whitespace, and truncates to 25 characters.
- [tests/helper/ui.ts](tests/helper/ui.ts): reusable command/value-set/location selectors scope to dialogs or popovers and wait for visibility; `expectToast()` asserts text within `.toaster.group`; `clickTabOrMenuItem()` supports responsive navigation.
- [tests/helper/questionnaire.ts](tests/helper/questionnaire.ts): `submitForm()`, `submitAndExpectSuccess()`, field/visibility helpers, and submitted-value assertions. No dedicated pharmacy or billing-account helper exists under `tests/helper/`.
- [tests/facility/services/helpers.ts](tests/facility/services/helpers.ts): `createHealthcareService(page, facilityId, serviceName, servicesUrl)` creates a Pharmacy-type service attached to a Pharmacy location; `toggleSidebar(page, expand)` controls navigation layout. No shared location-ID or prescription-ID helper exists.

**4. Billing Account Setup**
[tests/setup/patientAccount.setup.ts](tests/setup/patientAccount.setup.ts) visits `facility/${facilityId}/patient/${patientId}/accounts?status=active`, checks “Go to account”, and either opens an existing account or creates one using `faker.finance.accountName()`, “Name *”, and “Create”. It extracts `/account/([a-f0-9-]+)` and saves account metadata. **It filters active status only, not open billing status.**
[accountTransfer.spec.ts](tests/facility/billing/accountTransfer.spec.ts#L17) has local, non-exported API helpers: `createAccount()` POSTs `/api/v1/facility/${facilityId}/account/` with `{name,status,billing_status,patient,service_period:{start:ISODate}}`; `updateAccount()` PUTs the detail endpoint with account data plus updates; `getAccount()` GETs the detail endpoint. `createPatient()` fetches a government organization and POSTs a unique patient. Setup creates active accounts with `open`, `billing`, and `carecomplete_notbilled`, plus nine combinations of non-active statuses and those billing statuses; teardown deactivates the three active accounts.
Other account matches are permission/payment specs, [backButton.spec.ts](tests/facility/components/backButton.spec.ts), and unrelated user “Delete Account”/login wording. None checks the pharmacy’s active+open account condition. **Avoid mutating the shared patient’s accounts:** [playwright.config.ts](playwright.config.ts) enables parallel tests and locally depends on setup, including patient-account setup.

**5. Exact Route And Warning Behavior**
[FacilityRoutes.tsx](src/Routers/routes/FacilityRoutes.tsx#L49) delegates `/facility/:facilityId/locations/:locationId*` to [LocationLayout.tsx](src/pages/Facility/locations/LocationLayout.tsx#L64), which defines:
```text
/facility/:facilityId/locations/:locationId/medication_requests/patient/:patientId/bill/prescriptions/:prescriptionIds
```
`prescriptionIds` is comma-separated and split into an array; this route has no encounter parameter. [BillMedicationsByPrescriptions.tsx](src/pages/Facility/services/pharmacy/billMedications/BillMedicationsByPrescriptions.tsx) renders the warning alongside its billing shell. [NoActiveAccountWarningDialog.tsx](src/pages/Facility/billing/account/components/NoActiveAccountWarningDialog.tsx#L37) GETs accounts with `{patient:patientId,limit:1,status:"active",billing_status:"open"}` and opens after fetching completes when `count === 0`. “Proceed” only dismisses it, without immediately creating an account; “Go to Accounts” navigates to `/facility/${facilityId}/billing/account?patient_filter=${patientId}`.

**6. Exact English Strings**
From [public/locale/en.json](public/locale/en.json#L3683): `no_active_account_found` = **“No active account found”**; `no_active_account_warning_description` = **“This patient does not have an active billing account. Proceeding with this action will create a new billing account for the patient.”**; `go_to_accounts` = **“Go to Accounts”**; `proceed` = **“Proceed”**.

**7. Dialog Assertion Patterns**
[tests/PLAYWRIGHT_GUIDE.md](tests/PLAYWRIGHT_GUIDE.md#L319) recommends visibility/hidden assertions, role/name button selection, navigation waits, authenticated storage, and unique test data. It has **no dedicated alert-dialog section**. The concrete alert-dialog template is [activityDefinitionDelete.spec.ts](tests/facility/settings/activityDefinition/activityDefinitionDelete.spec.ts#L46): select `page.getByRole("alertdialog")`, assert visibility and description, then click a button scoped inside it. [paymentSheetUrl.spec.ts](tests/billing/paymentSheetUrl.spec.ts#L24) instead filters ordinary dialogs by heading and asserts disappearance/URL changes. For this warning, the corresponding assertion shape is:
```typescript
const dialog = page.getByRole("alertdialog", { name: "No active account found" });
await expect(dialog).toBeVisible();
await expect(dialog.getByText("This patient does not have an active billing account. Proceeding with this action will create a new billing account for the patient.")).toBeVisible();
await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Proceed", exact: true }).click();
await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();
```
Use separate coverage for “Go to Accounts” and its filtered URL, plus an active+open account negative case. For that negative case, wait for the account query to finish before asserting absence, since the component initially renders nothing while fetching.
